name: Archetype
description: A total toolhead ecosystem with a focus on modularity and flexibility for Voron 2.4 and Trident printers. Includes multiple variants (Atrocity, Blackbird, Breakneck, Mantis, Mjolnir, Zephyr) each targeting different fan configurations and use cases. Shares the Xol-Carriage mounting system.

fanMounts: Varies by variant (3515 axial, 4010 blower, 5015 blower, CPAP)

features: Multiple toolhead variants (Atrocity, Blackbird, Breakneck, Mantis, Mjolnir, Zephyr)
Modular ecosystem with shared carriage platform
Wide fan configuration options per variant
